About Genartml

We build the systems businesses run on, and we answer for them personally.

Genartml Private Limited is a software and AI studio in Ahmedabad, established in 2024. We build AI workflows, voice AI agents, websites and custom software for businesses in India and abroad, and we build and run our own education products, Evoluter and Extuter.

01Our story

Fixed price, because that is how we would want to buy.

Most businesses that have bought software have a story about a project that ran over: an estimate that doubled, an hourly bill nobody could check, a launch date that kept moving.

Genartml was set up in 2024 to work the other way. Every project has a written scope, a fixed price and a delivery date in working days before any work starts. You see a live test link every Friday. When it is done, the code, designs and data are yours.

We also build our own products. Running Evoluter and Extuter in production is how we stay honest about what AI can and cannot do, and it is where most of our engineering standards come from.

03Engineering philosophy

How we work, in three rules.

They shape every proposal, every build and every handover.

01

No agency buzzwords

If a proposal needs an adjective to sound good, the scope is not clear yet. We describe what the system does, what it costs and when it lands, in the words your team uses.

02

Proof over promises

A price, a date and a working test link every Friday say more than a pitch deck. We would rather show you than tell you.

03

One person answers for it

Every project is personally inspected and signed off by founder Daksh Suthar before it goes live. That is an operating rule, not a tagline.
